The '''D-60 assault droid''' was a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2-series super battle droid]] variant used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Some of them were deployed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], as well as the [[Attack on Cartao]]. They also featured [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on their arms and a slightly different appearance than the B2 super battle droid.<ref name="Hero" />
